title: Cause and heart
note: Above the heart it is 恩, grace. A form with the heart at the side, 㤙, exists only as a rare variant of the same word.

title: Loss and heart
note: Stacked, the heart forgets. Side by side, it is busy.

title: Centre and heart
note: The same two parts give loyalty or unease.

title: 台 and heart
note: Lazy when stacked, glad when side by side.

title: The lesser and heart
note: Put something lesser above the heart and it becomes evil. Compare 因 above the heart, which is grace.

title: 'As' and heart
note: Forgiveness: as my heart is, so is yours.

title: Slave and heart
note: Anger. Compare it with the one above.

title: Head and heart
note: Thinking. The 田 was once the crown of the skull.

title: One and the great
note: Heaven; and with the stroke lower down, something else.

title: Mouth and tree
note: Three everyday characters from the same two parts.
